fact: The acting president of the National Statistical Council said the Ministry of Economy and Planning, through the Council, is preparing to put forward a new draft statistics law to replace the 1999 law, at the JEFA statistical information forum held 5-6 June 2026 in Mahdia.
title: تونس تسن قانونًا إحصائيًا جديدًا لتعزيز حوكمة البيانات
